/**************************************************************************

***************************************************************************/

module CGA_MAC_SEGPT_XPT (
    // System input signals
    input sysclk,    // System clock in FPGA
    input sys_rst_n, // System reset in FPGA

    // Input signals
    input       EXMN,
    input [2:0] FIDBO_2_0,  //! FIDBO output from previous stage (from CGA_MAC.FIDBO_15_0[2:0])
    input       LLDEXM,
    input       MCLKN,

    // Output signals
    output       PEX,
    output       VEX,  //! Vector EXecute signal (to CGA_MAC.VEX)
    output [1:0] XPT_1_0
);

  /*******************************************************************************
   ** The wires are defined here                                                 **
   *******************************************************************************/
  wire [1:0] s_xpt_1_0_out;
  wire [2:0] s_fidbo_2_0;
  wire       s_exm_n;
  wire       s_exm;
  wire       s_gates1_out;
  wire       s_lldexm;
  wire       s_mclk_n;
  wire       s_pex_out;
  wire       s_vex_out;
  wire       s_xpt_qc_n;
  wire       s_xpt_qc;

  /*******************************************************************************
   ** The module functionality is described here                                 **
   *******************************************************************************/

  /*******************************************************************************
   ** Here all input connections are defined                                     **
   *******************************************************************************/
  assign s_fidbo_2_0[2:0] = FIDBO_2_0;
  assign s_mclk_n         = MCLKN;
  assign s_lldexm         = LLDEXM;
  assign s_exm_n          = EXMN;

  /*******************************************************************************
   ** Here all output connections are defined                                    **
   *******************************************************************************/
  assign PEX              = s_pex_out;
  assign VEX              = s_vex_out;
  assign XPT_1_0          = s_xpt_1_0_out[1:0];

  /*******************************************************************************
   ** Here all in-lined components are defined                                   **
   *******************************************************************************/

  // NOT Gate
  assign s_exm            = ~s_exm_n;

  /*******************************************************************************
   ** Here all normal components are defined                                     **
   *******************************************************************************/
  AND_GATE #(
      .BubblesMask(2'b00)
  ) GATES_1 (
      .input1(s_mclk_n),
      .input2(s_lldexm),
      .result(s_gates1_out)
  );

  AND_GATE #(
      .BubblesMask(2'b00)
  ) GATES_2 (
      .input1(s_exm),
      .input2(s_xpt_qc),
      .result(s_vex_out)
  );

  AND_GATE #(
      .BubblesMask(2'b00)
  ) GATES_3 (
      .input1(s_xpt_qc_n),
      .input2(s_exm),
      .result(s_pex_out)
  );


  /*******************************************************************************
   ** Here all sub-circuits are defined                                          **
   *******************************************************************************/

  L4 XPT_L
  (
    // Input signals
    .sysclk(sysclk),                          // System clock in FPGA
    .sys_rst_n(sys_rst_n),                    // System reset in FPGA

    // Input signals
    .L  (s_gates1_out),
    .A  (s_fidbo_2_0[0]),
    .B  (s_fidbo_2_0[1]),
    .C  (s_fidbo_2_0[2]),
    .D  (1'b0),

    //Output signals
    .QA (s_xpt_1_0_out[0]),
    .QAN(),
    .QB (s_xpt_1_0_out[1]),
    .QBN(),
    .QC (s_xpt_qc),
    .QCN(s_xpt_qc_n),
    .QD (),
    .QDN(),
    // registered-value taps: deliberately unconnected here -
    // the transparent output is the wanted one (see L8/L4 header).
    .QA_R(),
    .QB_R(),
    .QC_R(),
    .QD_R()
  );

endmodule
